verdict.rationale: Microsoft docs describe configurable version-history retention for OneDrive/SharePoint files (onedrive-docs-8, onedrive-docs-23) and Graph API support for tracking created/updated/deleted items (onedrive-docs-6, onedrive-docs-21), suggesting some retention/deletion control exists. However, multiple hands-on community reports describe files being deleted, reverted to old versions, or rendered unrecoverable without user intent, directly undermining the claim that users can reliably control retention/deletion (onedrive-comm-2, onedrive-comm-5, onedrive-comm-13). Missing for 10: explicit AI-native/API-level documentation of user-initiated deletion or retention policy controls, independent verification that these controls work reliably in practice, and reconciliation of the documented retention feature with reported data-loss incidents.
